text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:

tear off...! Normally, a height like this 
would be nothing... Urgh.

It feels like she's always falling over, 
but if she says she's feeling off, could 
it be fatigue from the race? I should 
review her schedule to make sure she's not 
being overworked.
